note: Wall time each GitHub actions/runs read of the ci-read step (mc_ci_state, mc_ci_flake_runs) may take before it is cut (BH-6346). A cut read is CI unavailable (the row waits) and writes one CI_READ_HELD reason=read-timeout line per (PR, head), with no STEP_TIMEOUT, no alert and no Sentry event; the next tick reads again. Not a number reads as 30. Settings row: lane.merge-conductor.mc_ci_read_timeout_s.
